description: This file defines CPU-related macros, inline functions for interrupt control, and utility functions like ilog2, tailored for different compilers. It is part of the Arctic Core AUTOSAR platform, providing hardware abstraction for CPU interrupt management.

methods.name: _Irq_Disable_save
methods.description: Saves current interrupt state and disables interrupts, returning previous state.

methods.name: _Irq_Disable_restore
methods.description: Restores interrupt state from saved flags.
